notes.title: POWER reset with 100 nations!
notes.content:
Power has been fully reset with 100 nations, civil wars, expanded organized crime, and a bunch of other new stuff!

A true geopolitical grand strategy MMO now, give it another try!

notes.title: Brazil & India added to POWER!
notes.content:
Two new nations, Brazil and India have been added to the game and are now available for registration!

Brazil has 5 regions, and is the first country in South America to be added to the game.

India has 6 regions, and is the first country in Asia to be added to the game.

More countries are expected to be added in the future, but first we need the players to join up so we can populate them, so come join the game!

notes.title: Germany and Russia to be added to POWER!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38571728/1464629d698756b7aca343bd315059efe613b5ed.png[/img]

With steam release on the 3rd, POWER will be introducing Germany to the game and, player numbers allowing, Russia.

Germany will be divided into its current existing states, while Russian regions will be the current Federal Districts. Both will feature elections to their respective legislatures, the Bundestag and Gosduma. As with all other countries, they will be able to fully interact geopolitically and economically in the world.
